name: Buckley SFB
description: Buckley SFB hosts Space Delta 4 missile warning operations and Space Base Delta 2 in the Denver metro area. Home of the 460th Space Wing and a major joint-force installation with Army, Navy, and National Guard tenants.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate. All visitors must obtain a base pass — Trusted Traveler Program suspended.

gates.name: Mississippi Gate (Main Gate)
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 gate. Can issue visitor passes when VCC is closed (up to 72 hours). Visitor Control Center located here.
gates.address: E. Mississippi Ave & Aspen St, Aurora, CO 80011

gates.name: 6th Avenue Gate
gates.notes: Closed weekends, federal holidays, and SBD 2 down days. Large Vehicle Inspection Point (LVIP) for moving vans east of this gate.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (Mississippi Gate)
gates.notes: Walk-in only. Closed weekends, federal holidays, and SBD 2 down days. Pre-register visitors via DBIDS/DVES. REAL ID required.

events.title: Newcomers Briefing

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your Unit Command Support Staff (CSS) during duty hours. Attend the newcomers briefing at the Military & Family Readiness Center. Visit Finance in Bldg 1030 for travel voucher.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Housing Management Office before arrival. All personnel must visit HMO before signing any off-base lease. Rocky Mountain Lodge offers temporary lodging — book early during PCS season.

sections.title: Gate Access
sections.body: Mississippi Gate is open 24/7. 6th Avenue Gate is Mon-Fri 0600-1800. Visitor Control Center hours are Mon-Fri 0700-1500. REAL ID required for all visitors.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Official installation resources plus Military OneSource and BaseDirectory for relocation support.
